## Checklist (the contribution check enforces most of this)
- [ ] Skills, workflow, engine, effects, styles, docs or templates only
- [ ] No assets or media, no brand-specific text, no keys, no personal paths or emails
- [ ] A check proves it (selftest, gate or example) and `python3 ledger/contribute.py check` passes
- [ ] Edited `.claude/` (source) and ran `python3 adapters/codex.py`
- [ ] Opened from a fork; draft until the check is green
